datasets.product: Mars Global Surveyor Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter Mission Experiment Gridded Data Records: topography
datasets.license: NASA/PDS archived data; retain the dataset citation and follow PDS citation guidance.
datasets.citation: Smith, D. E., M. T. Zuber, G. A. Neumann, E. A. Guinness, and S. Slavney (2003). Mars Global Surveyor Laser Altimeter Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record, MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0, NASA Planetary Data System. https://doi.org/10.17189/1519460
limitations: The gridded DEM includes interpolation between altimetry tracks.
Its approximately 463 m equatorial sampling is coarser than the Earth DEM and must not be visually over-interpreted.

datasets.license: NASA Earth science data use guidance; verify collection and granule metadata before redistribution
datasets.unit: m relative to the EGM96 geoid
datasets.citation: NASA JPL (2020). NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001 [Data set]. NASA EOSDIS Land Processes DAAC. https://doi.org/10.5067/MEaSUREs/NASADEM/NASADEM_HGT.001
limitations: Ground sampling distance varies with latitude on the geographic grid.
Earth terrain and the EGM96 vertical reference are not physically equivalent to Mars MOLA terrain and areoid.
